items.title: Internal knowledge assistant for a edtech company
items.text:
# Internal knowledge assistant for a edtech company

## Context
Corvid Edtech needed a chat assistant that answers staff questions from 1200 internal documents. The existing process was slow and error-prone.

## What I built
I designed and delivered a chat assistant that answers staff questions from 1200 internal documents. The stack: scripting the whole backend end to end, LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation, Qdrant, FastAPI, OpenAI API, docker-compose.

## Outcome
The result cut average search time from 7 minutes to 16 seconds.

items.title: Support ticket triage with a fine-tuned language model (media)
items.text:
# Support ticket triage with a fine-tuned language model (media)

## Context
Harbor Media needed a fine-tuned classifier that routes tickets to the right queue. The existing process was slow and error-prone.

## What I built
I designed and delivered a fine-tuned classifier that routes tickets to the right queue. The stack: fine-tuned a pretrained encoder from the model hub, QLoRA, torch, classified free-text support tickets by intent, scripting the whole backend end to end, Qdrant.

## Outcome
The result routing accuracy of 83% on 800 tickets.

items.title: Real-time shelf monitoring with computer vision for media retail
items.text:
# Real-time shelf monitoring with computer vision for media retail

## Context
Juniper Media needed a detector that flags empty shelves from store cameras. The existing process was slow and error-prone.

## What I built
I designed and delivered a detector that flags empty shelves from store cameras. The stack: YOLOv8, image preprocessing: deskewing, thresholding and contour detection, torch, docker-compose.

## Outcome
The result 71% detection mAP at 8 frames per second.
